en: Black‑and‑white seaside view showing a large, elegant, Mediterranean-style building with arched loggias along a promenade. In the foreground there are stone terraces and railings leading down to a narrow beach. To the right is a calm bay with small waterfront structures on stilts, and in the background are low, barren hills under a sky with scattered clouds. The word "NOVI" is printed in the top-left corner.
